about: Every dynamic variable the core's resolver generates (vars::DYNAMIC_VARIABLES), with what autocomplete shows for it (src/lib/vars.ts). A test in vars.rs fails if the two lists differ. args is the argument hint; required means the variable is nothing without its argument. A name ending in '.' takes a name straight after it.

variables.name: $timestamp
variables.description: Unix time in seconds, optionally offset (-1 d)

variables.name: $random.alphanumeric
variables.description: Random letters and digits (10 by default)

variables.name: $datetime
variables.description: Current UTC time: rfc1123, iso8601 or a pattern

variables.name: $processEnv
variables.description: An environment variable of HttpDesk's process

variables.name: $dotenv
variables.description: A value from the .env file beside the .http file
